meta.name: Transsion/XOS Secret Codes
meta.source: Reverse-engineered from Factory.apk + EngineerMode.apk (X6525, XOS Android 13) and field-verified
meta.access_chain: Factory-reset welcome screen -> select language & country -> connect WiFi -> click Next -> on the Agreement page tap the 'Personalized Recommendations' privacy-policy link -> Chrome opens -> type 'frpbypass' in the address bar -> on the frpbypass site find the DIALER link and open it -> the phone's real Dialer app opens despite OOBE lock -> dial *#*#49#*#* -> ADB enables persistently

codes.detail: Sets persist.sys.usb.config=adb; survives reboot and setup state. The key unlock code.
Full Unisoc engineering mode: hardware tests, AT commands, NV access UI.

notes: EMERGENCY DIALER LIMITATION (field-verified): the lock-screen emergency call pad does NOT process *#*#49#*#* on Infinix Smart 8 / XOS 13 (ums9230). Secret codes require the full Dialer app - reach it via the OOBE browser/tel:-link chain, or on MTK-based Tecno/Infinix some builds accept #*#49#*#* in emergency mode.
Alternate code *#85# reported working on some Transsion models.
Direct SECRET_CODE broadcast from shell uid is denied - system permission required.
